title: Sunday · five hundred pages
logline: The arc's Sunday, the week after 'Of what': the garage floor from above, the pages being gathered into a box, the dog sitting on the one page left. The strip never says which page.

panels.composition: Tier 1: straight down. The garage floor covered in typed pages, five hundred, edge to edge, in rows. A dog walking across them diagonally, leaving no marks. Two boots at the top edge: Wood's.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a straight-down view of a garage floor covered edge to edge with typed manuscript pages in rows, a small dog walking diagonally across them, a man's boots at the top edge, no words
image.notes: The novel's pages: draw typed text as gray texture, unreadable.

panels.name: Floor

panels.composition: Tier 2: Wood from above, on his knees, gathering pages into a box. The dog walking the rows ahead of him.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a straight-down view of a man on his knees gathering typed pages into a box while a small dog walks the rows ahead of him, no words

panels.name: Door

panels.composition: Tier 3: straight down again. The floor bare wood now except one page in the middle, and the dog sitting on it. A cardboard box at the edge, full. Held.

characters.pose: sitting on the one page left

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a straight-down view of a bare garage floor with a single typed page in the middle and a small dog sitting on it, a full cardboard box at the edge, no words
image.notes: Which page is reserved. The dog sits on it.
